answers.core:
Yes, I'm aware of https://github.com/godotengine/godot-git-plugin/
The main reason why it has to be added to core - it's meant to be mainly informational feature (plus "revert block" function).
Despite functionality that it may suggest - I personally don't need it, as prefer to interact with Git via CLI or, in complicated cases, something UI-based, like SmartGit.
answers.workaround: I don't think there are a "few line solution" for this. Also - suggested enhancement will be used on constant basis.
